The '''Trandoshan Fleet''' was an [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] associated with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The fleet was funded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to support the [[Clone Wars/Legends|conflict]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Trandoshans used their fleet several times to attack the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], home to a enemy race of furry [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. The fleet consisted of some [[Starship/Legends|ship]] classes, including [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter]] and [[Trandoshan dropship]].

==History==
One [[Trandoshan dropship]], using [[Salvage droid/Legends|scavenger droids]], managed to [[Attack on the Prosecutor|capture]] the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ship]] [[Prosecutor]]. Upon the [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|arrival]] of the elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] group [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], the [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] remained destroyed.<ref name="SWRC" />

The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] planned to launch a massive [[Attack on Kashyyyk|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], homeworld of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], but they lacked a significant number of [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], offered financial assistance, [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and a personal [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Providence-class carrier/destroyer]], the ''[[Nihilist]]''.<ref name="Kinect" />

During [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Mavra Zane|Mavra Zane's]] [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] on the planet Kashyyyk, the Separatists, along with their [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|army]] and the newly formed Trandoshan [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], launched a massive attack on the planet. Following the victory on Kashyyyk, the fleet moved to [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. On their [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''Nihilist'' Commerce Guild presented the Trandoshans with an army of specially painted battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. After the Jedi forces [[Rebellion on Felucia|arrived]], the ship was blown up along with its crew.<ref name="Kinect" />

Some of Trandoshan dropships were used during [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWRC" />
